name: Kunoichi Shokushu Jigoku Hen
source:
A lusty battle comic featuring a kunoichi who is pulled into tentacle hell!
While she struggles to break free, aphrodisiac fluids are pumped into her until she swells in size!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233377.html]DLsite English[/url]]
